UP International Trade Show Inaugurated by Amit Shah and Yogi Adityanath

The Uttar Pradesh International Trade Show commenced in Greater Noida, with Union Home Minister Amit Shah and Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath inaugurating the event. CM Yogi Adityanath stated that Uttar Pradesh's traditional strengths would gain new recognition on a global platform, and its skills would shine internationally.
